strategies.title: Enlarged Tile Sizes
strategies.summary: Increase BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, and BASE_K from 64 to 128.

strategies.title: WorkspaceQueue Pattern
strategies.summary: Replace raw CrossCoreSetFlag/WaitFlag with a typed WorkspaceQueue class that encapsulates workspace ring-buffer management.

strategies.title: Q L1 Cache Skip
strategies.summary: Add a Q chunk caching mechanism in the Cube (AIC) side.

strategies.title: Vectorized RowMuls/RowDivs
strategies.summary: Replace scalar RowMulsImpl/RowDivsImpl (which use GetValue per-row loops) with vectorized RowMuls/RowDivs helper functions.

strategies.title: Softmax UB State Cache
strategies.summary: Cache softmax max/sum/exp states per ring slot in UB (maxCacheBuf_, sumCacheBuf_, expCacheBuf_) instead of writing them to GM workspace (wsMeta).

strategies.title: Targeted SetWaitFlag
strategies.summary: Replace all PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL> with targeted SetWaitFlag<HardEvent::X_Y> calls.

strategies.title: oPrev Dedicated TBuf
strategies.summary: Allocate a dedicated TBuf<VECCALC> oPrevBuf_ for Vec2 O accumulation instead of using a TQue slot.

strategies.title: Multi-level KV Outer Tiling
strategies.summary: Implement a two-level KV sequence tiling scheme with s2OuterBlocks and s2BaseSize.

strategies.title: Single KV L1 Buffer
strategies.summary: Use a single kvBufL1_ (TBuf<A1>) for K and a single vBufL1_ (TBuf<A1>) for V, instead of double-buffered kBufL1_0/1 and vBufL1_0/1.

strategies.title: KV Remain Handling
strategies.summary: Handle dim values that are not divisible by BASE_K with kRemain/nRemain loops.
